title: On Challenges in Evaluation Methodology: A Review
abstract: arXiv:2604.25923v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in language models have prompted a growing body of work that questions prevailing evaluation practices. However, many such critiques have already been discussed in natural language processing (NLP), a field with a long history of methodological reflection on evaluation. We conduct a scoping review spanning four decades and develop a taxonomy of 22 recurring concerns. For each concern, we examine how recently it was discussed in the reviewed literature and whether it receives explicit attention in institutional checklists, finding that some concerns have become less visible in literature and many lack coverage in these checklists. Our work provides an overview of the major concerns in evaluation methodology that have shaped the field and identifies potential targets for renewed investigation and field-level intervention by the research community.

translated_title: 关于评估方法论挑战的研究：综述
translated_abstract: 语言模型的最新进展促使越来越多的研究开始质疑当前通行的评估实践。然而，许多此类批评早已在自然语言处理（NLP）领域中被讨论过，该领域在评估方法论的反思方面有着悠久的历史。我们进行了一项跨越四十年的范围综述，并构建了一个包含22个反复出现的问题的分类体系。针对每个问题，我们考察了其在所回顾文献中被讨论的近期程度，以及是否在机构检查清单中得到明确关注，结果发现一些问题在文献中的可见度已有所下降，且许多问题缺乏这些检查清单的覆盖。我们的工作概述了塑造该领域的评估方法论主要问题，并为研究社区重新开展调查和实施领域层面的干预确定了潜在目标。
tldr: 本文通过跨越四十年的范围综述构建了包含22项反复出现的评估方法论问题的分类体系，发现许多问题在文献中的可见度下降且缺乏机构检查清单的覆盖，从而为未来的重新研究和领域层面干预指明了方向。
